Subject: Draft phased adoption MAP and commercial questions

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the product demo today — the latency profile on short chat sessions looks promising for our POC. I attached a first-pass phased adoption MAP that lays out a 3-stage evaluation into production (pilot -> ramp -> enterprise). The team here wants clarity on two commercial points before we lock timelines:

- Pricing triggers: what usage thresholds (monthly tokens / concurrent sessions) move us to the next price band?
- Renewal uplift: if we hit the ramp targets, what caps do you apply to year-2 price uplifts? We need predictability for forecasting.

We've penciled a target close window of end-of-month to align budget sign-off; happy to stretch that if we agree on milestones + a short-term credit.

Subject: Re: Draft phased adoption MAP and commercial questions

Elena —

Appreciate the clear MAP. High level response and a few clarifying asks below; I copied Neha and Ben to help with pricing and SRE-sizing.

1) Pricing triggers: we typically define three tiers tied to monthly token volumes and sustained qps during peak windows. For your MAP we can propose:
   - Pilot (0–5M tokens / month): hosted rate A (no commit)
   - Ramp (5M–50M tokens / month): 6-month ramp commitment with a 12% blended discount if you commit to a 6-month volume floor
   - Enterprise (50M+ tokens / month): annual commit with a 20% discount + reserved capacity options

2) Renewal uplift cap: we can offer a capped uplift formula tied to CPI + fixed band. Practically, we can lock year-2 uplift to no more than +8% if you meet the Stage 2 ramp milestones. If Stage 2 is missed by >25%, uplift reverts to list pricing adjustments.

3) Timing and credits: to hit your end-of-month close, we can attach a $20k pilot credit that applies to Pilot months if you sign the MAP by Aug 31.

Open items for you: expected weekly QPS, P95 latency SLA requirement, and whether you need private deployment (VPC) or hosted. Those inputs will affect the SOW and capacity pricing.

I've attached a short commercial term sheet that maps milestones to credits and discounts. Ben — can you confirm whether the SRE sizing below assumes VPC?

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: commercial_term_sheet_v2.xlsx

Sergio — thanks, this helps. Quick answers:

- We plan to start Pilot Sept 7 with an estimated 2M tokens/week (peak days ~250k tokens).
- If the Pilot is successful, we expect a weekly ramp to ~1.2M tokens/day by end of Stage 2 (roughly 30M tokens/month).
- We prefer hosted initially; VPC is a hard requirement only for Stage 3 (enterprise).

On renewal uplift: Phaseware's finance team needs a predictable cap. Your +8% cap if Stage 2 is met sounds reasonable — would you be willing to add language that limits cumulative uplift across year-2 to +8% even if list prices for some components increase more? We want a contractual safety valve for forecasting.

Also, can we get a short SOW redline so procurement can run the legal checklist? Attaching a redline request doc.
